670:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Once again, this is hardly the time to be saying all that, but we're open for business anyway!」

670:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our celebration for the ace pilots will have to wait, but today we're ready to... sell, sell, sell!」

671:t_000:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It's $$ミカゲ$$! He broke into the $$クォーター$$ and took $$ランカ$$!」

671:t_001:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$! Answer me, $$ランカ$$!」

671:t_001:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You're sad, aren't you, girl with the pale green hair? Your heart is breaking, isn't it, being torn from the one you love...?」

671:t_001:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have endured that sorrow, pain and suffering for tens of thousands... hundreds of millions of times longer than you.」

671:t_001:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And... the girl with the pink and golden hair will now suffer even greater sorrow, pain and anguish than you, for all eternity.」

671:t_001:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And it is your fault, and his... The one you cherish chooses you, and makes the other person he cherishes suffer.」

671:t_001:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes... Your very existence is the sin behind it all.」

671:t_001:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... She will probably never sing again.」

671:t_001:11.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! What the hell are you saying to $$ランカ$$?!」

671:t_001:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's too late. She has fallen.」

671:t_001:16.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have waited so long for this moment. It took a different course than I expected, but the fruit of despair has ripened.」

671:t_001:17.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Her despair, my love and hatred... When these three come together, a new power is born.」

671:t_001:18.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes... That power is the $$暗黒の翼$$!」

671:t_002:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$! Answer me, $$ランカ$$!」

671:t_002:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You're sad, aren't you, girl with the pale green hair? Your heart is breaking, isn't it, being torn from the one you love...?」

671:t_002:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have endured that sorrow, pain and suffering for tens of thousands... hundreds of millions of times longer than you.」

671:t_002:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But... girl with the pale green hair, even if he comes to rescue you, you will not be allowed to leap into his arms.」

671:t_002:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No matter how loudly you call... no matter how much you sing, your feelings will never reach his heart.」

671:t_002:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You are not the one he will hold in his arms.」

671:t_002:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... Even your attempt to sneak into his heart while the girl with the pink and golden hair was away was all in vain.」

671:t_002:10.en:
$$ランカ$$
「That's not true... That's not true! I...!」

671:t_002:11.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's all right, girl with the pale green hair. I will save your unrequited love.」

671:t_002:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! What the hell are you saying to $$ランカ$$?!」

671:t_002:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's too late. She has fallen.」

671:t_002:17.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have waited so long for this moment, for despair to grow slowly and quietly over time, and finally bear fruit.」

671:t_002:18.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Her despair, my love and hatred... When these three come together, a new power is born.」

671:t_002:19.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes... That power is the $$暗黒の翼$$!」

671:t_003:2.en:
$$カグラ$$
「What the hell's going on?! The $$神話型アクエリオン$$ is right here with us!」

671:t_003:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Love and hatred are two sides of the same coin...」

671:t_003:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「If the $$太陽の翼$$ embodies $$アポロニアス#pilot$$' filthy love for a Wingless, then my eternal hatred for the Wingless is this $$暗黒の翼$$...」

671:t_003:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes! This black Mechanical Angel is the reverse side of my love for $$アポロニアス#pilot$$!」

671:t_003:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! If you hate us, we'll fight you!」

671:t_003:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「And leave $$ランカ$$ out of it! She's got nothing to do with this!」

671:t_003:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「She has nothing to do with it...? Is that really true?」

671:t_003:11.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This girl tried to obtain love. That sin deserves ten thousand deaths...!」

671:t_003:12.en:
$$カレン$$
「Enough with your jealousy and taking it out on everyone else!」

671:t_003:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Do you intend to use everyone who loves each other as a tool for your revenge?!」

671:t_003:15.en:
$$桂$$
「Give me a break. That's the same as saying you're going to kill everyone in the world.」

671:t_003:16.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You may take it that way.」

671:t_003:18.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Soon, a massive outbreak of $$バアル$$ will begin the great collapse that will destroy every universe.」

671:t_003:19.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I will watch it unfold and reminisce about my days of love with $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, now so far away.」

671:t_003:20.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's no use...! There's no talking to him!」

671:t_003:21.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I never intended to converse with you Wingless in the first place. All you will find here is a miserable death.」

「Yes! This black Mechanical Angel is the reverse side of my love for $$アポロニアス#pilot$$!」
